assertions.title: Public booking detail and guest booking detail reuse one booking-detail model

steps.expected: Comparison harness shows public and guest booking-detail experiences side by side for the cancelled fixture
steps.observed: Harness rendered two comparison panels with matching action sets (PDF, Share, disabled Modify Details, disabled Cancel Booking, disabled Book Again) and identical Sign In CTAs.

steps.action: Inspect harness destination links for the public and guest panels
steps.expected: Public panel links to /bookings/[id] flow and guest panel links to /guest/bookings/[id] flow while preserving route-appropriate access
steps.observed: Harness linked to two distinct sign-in URLs, one recovering to /bookings/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555 and one recovering to /guest/bookings/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555.

steps.action: Navigate to the guest booking detail canonical destination
steps.expected: Guest route should resolve to the guest booking detail experience or a guest-route-specific redirect outcome
steps.observed: Opening /guest/bookings/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555?fixture=cancelled redirected through /bookings/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555?fixture=cancelled to /auth/signin?redirectedFrom=%2Fbookings%2Frecover%3Fnext%3D%252Fbookings%252F55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555%253Ffixture%253Dcancelled, collapsing the guest route onto the public recovery path.

assertions.issues: Guest booking detail currently canonicalizes through the public booking detail recovery path instead of preserving a distinct guest detail route outcome, so the real-surface route behavior does not match the comparison harness's separate guest/public model.

assertions.title: Booking detail disables management actions when lifecycle rules disallow them

steps.expected: Cancelled fixture should expose non-manageable booking detail state
steps.observed: Cancelled fixture loaded successfully in the comparison harness.

steps.action: Review action affordances in the cancelled booking detail panels
steps.expected: Modify/cancel actions are visibly unavailable for the cancelled lifecycle
steps.observed: Both comparison panels showed Modify Details, Cancel Booking, and Book Again buttons in disabled state while PDF and Share remained available.

evidence.network: Harness page loaded without additional network requests captured after initial document render.

assertions.title: Non-manageable booking states explain how the guest can regain control

steps.expected: Cancelled booking detail should present guidance for regaining control when management is unavailable
steps.observed: Both comparison panels included a visible Sign In CTA beneath the disabled management actions.

steps.expected: Guidance should direct the guest into a recovery/sign-in flow rather than silently hiding next steps
steps.observed: Opening /bookings/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555?fixture=cancelled redirected to /auth/signin?redirectedFrom=%2Fbookings%2Frecover%3Fnext%3D%252Fbookings%252F55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555%253Ffixture%253Dcancelled, showing the sign-in form as the next-step guidance.

frictions.description: The comparison harness renders two identical "Sign In →" links, so clicking by visible text alone is ambiguous in agent-browser strict mode.
frictions.resolution: Inspected the rendered href values with browser eval and navigated directly to the relevant canonical destinations for evidence.

summary: Tested 3 assertions on the cancelled comparison harness: VAL-BOOKING-006 and VAL-BOOKING-007 passed on the live surface, while VAL-CROSS-003 failed because the guest booking detail route collapses into the public recovery/sign-in path instead of preserving a distinct guest-route outcome.
